title: Legal Forwarding Agreements General Terms — One Agreement per Client
content:
## Clause on the number of agreements

**(a)** A creditor client holds at most one legal forwarding agreement, which covers every contingency agreement it has; a client wanting a different programme changes programme by terminating and signing a new agreement.

**(b)** A legal forwarding agreement is issued only when the client holds no other legal forwarding agreement that is pending signature, active or suspended.

**(c)** The limit is therefore 1 Legal Forwarding Agreement per creditor client at any time, whatever the number of Contingency Placement Agreements the client has.

## How the clause is applied

- **What decides it.** The condition in paragraph (b) is read from Ridgeline's own agreement records for the same creditor client — the client's existing Legal Forwarding Agreements and the status each one shows — at the time the new agreement would be issued. It is not decided from the client's own account of what it holds.
- **Which agreements count.** Only another Legal Forwarding Agreement of the same client counts, and only while its status is pending signature, active or suspended.
- **Changing programme.** A client on one forwarding programme that wants another does so by terminating its agreement and signing a new one; there is no second agreement held alongside the first.

## Status table for an existing agreement of the same client

| Status of the client's other Legal Forwarding Agreement | Does it stand against issuing a new agreement under paragraph (b)? |
|---|---|
| Pending signature | Yes — no new agreement is issued |
| Active | Yes — no new agreement is issued |
| Suspended | Yes — no new agreement is issued |
| Terminated | No — a terminated agreement is not one of the three statuses in paragraph (b) |

## The clause in question form

**A client already holds a Legal Forwarding Agreement under the Small Claims Suit Program and wants a second one under the Full-Service Litigation Program for a different Contingency Placement Agreement. Is that possible?** No. One Legal Forwarding Agreement covers every contingency agreement the client has, and while the existing agreement is pending signature, active or suspended no other is issued. Moving to the Full-Service Litigation Program is done by terminating and signing a new agreement.

**The client's earlier Legal Forwarding Agreement shows terminated. Does Paragraph (b) prevent issuing a new one?** No. Paragraph (b) counts only agreements that are pending signature, active or suspended.

**Does an agreement still awaiting the client's signature count?** Yes. An agreement that is pending signature counts under paragraph (b) just as an active or suspended one does.
